prompt: Who was the first person to be an American diplomatic minister to Romania and Serbia?
answer: Eugene Schuyler was the first American diplomatic minister to both Romania and Serbia. He was appointed the first U.S. diplomatic representative to Romania in 1880 and became the first U.S. minister to Serbia in 1882, serving concurrently from a post based in Athens.
